parsed.explanation: The write-up proves orbit invariance g(x+g(x))=g(x), but never uses positivity of every iterate to conclude g(x)≥0. Therefore “at most one positive value” does not justify V⊆{0,c}; negative values remain possible as written. One sentence repairs the gap: if g(u)<0, then repeated use of (4) gives f^n(u)=u+n g(u)>0 for every n, which is impossible for sufficiently large n.
